description: Frozen LLHB v1 treatment surface: the tool names and schema hash the pinned local `lovspor mcp` server serves. The surface is corpus-independent (the schemas come from build_server, not the documents) but interpreter-dependent: tool descriptions come from docstrings, and CPython 3.13 dedents docstrings at compile time, so the hash is only defined together with the `python` field below. A unit test regenerates this document from the code on every run — names on every interpreter, hash on the apparatus interpreter; if the served surface changes, that test fails and changing this file is an explicit apparatus decision, not drift. A run made on a different interpreter records a different hash and fails the fairness gate. check_fairness.py reads this document as the expectation the declared tool_config is compared against.
